swimsuit.title: Swimwear Quiz
swimsuit.intro: Lido, lake, ocean, or pool. Wherever you swim this season, we’ve got you covered. Take our 2-minute quiz to find the swimsuit that’s right for you.
swimsuit.results_intro: Based on your answers, we’ve selected swimwear made for your swim style. Streamlined, comfortable and built for frequent sessions, they’re made to work hard in the water. Whether you’re swimming lengths, building your endurance, or lounging by the water, our swimwear can do it all.

goggles.title: Goggles Quiz
goggles.intro: Find the right goggles for your swim. Answer three quick questions and we’ll match you with goggles built for your sessions.
goggles.results_intro: We’ve selected swimming goggles based on your quiz results to help you find the right fit for your swim style. Designed for comfort, visibility and performance, these goggles are ideal for everything from fitness swimming and lane sessions to everyday time in the pool.
